item.title: Show HN: Atlas.nvim – Review PRs Inside Neovim
item.summary: Atlas.nvim lets you review PRs directly inside Neovim. Browse diffs, view and reply to comments, resolve threads, and leave local notes. Feedback is very welcome. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49322106 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
